questions.question_text: The property and tenancy management system shall mask personal information in non-production environments.
The property and tenancy management system shall allow documents of up to 100 MB to be attached to a record.
The property and tenancy management system shall support full-text search across all records the user is permitted to see.
The property and tenancy management system shall support retention rules that can be set by record type.
The property and tenancy management system shall send an email notification when a workflow step is assigned to a user.
The property and tenancy management system shall allow authorized users to export any report to Excel and PDF.
The property and tenancy management system shall provide a documented REST API covering every function available in the user interface.
The property and tenancy management system shall take a daily backup that can be restored to any point within the previous 14 days.
The property and tenancy management system shall retain deleted records for 30 days before permanent removal.
The property and tenancy management system shall support at least 500 named users at the same time without degradation.
The property and tenancy management system shall validate Canadian postal codes and street addresses.
The property and tenancy management system shall support role-based access control with at least five configurable roles.
The property and tenancy management system shall allow administrators to define fields and pick lists without code changes.
The property and tenancy management system should support electronic signatures that are legally binding in Alberta.
The property and tenancy management system should provide a mobile application for iOS and Android.
The property and tenancy management system shall allow all data to be extracted in a documented, non-proprietary format at any time.
The property and tenancy management system shall support single sign-on with the identity provider used by the Housing Corporation.
The property and tenancy management system shall record every create, update and delete action with the user and time stamp.
The property and tenancy management system shall provide a test environment for trying upgrades before they reach production.
The property and tenancy management system shall provide an administrator dashboard showing system health and usage.
Describe how rent-geared-to-income amounts are calculated and recalculated when household income changes.
Describe the mobile application used by inspectors, including offline operation.
Does the property and tenancy management system track maintenance work orders from request to completion? (Yes/No)
Describe how the applicant waitlist is prioritized and audited.
Attach a sample inspection report generated by the property and tenancy management system.
Describe the warranty provided and what it excludes.
Provide a work plan in tabular form showing milestones, deliverables, responsibilities and dates.
Describe your project management methodology and how progress will be reported to the Housing Corporation.
State every assumption and exclusion that affects the prices quoted.
Complete the Pricing Schedule in Appendix C, showing all prices in Canadian dollars and excluding GST.
questions.constraints: Appendix C; Canadian dollars, excluding GST
